title: HR Administrator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Administrator
Crewe
Immediate Start
3 months

Your new companyA well-established organisation is seeking an experienced HR Administrator to join its busy People team on an initial 3-month temporary contract. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive HR professional to gain exposure to a broad range of HR activities within a fast-paced and supportive environment.Your new role
As HR Administrator, you will provide essential administrative support across the employee life cycle, ensuring HR processes are delivered efficiently and accurately. Duties will include:
- Supporting onboarding and offboarding processes, including preparing contracts and employment documentation.
- Maintaining employee records and ensuring HR systems are accurately updated.
- Coordinating recruitment administration, including interview scheduling and pre-employment checks.
- Managing HR inbox queries and acting as a first point of contact for employees and managers.
- Supporting payroll administration through the accurate processing of employee changes.
- Maintaining compliance records, right-to-work documentation, and training records.
- Assisting with sickness absence administration and employee relations documentation.
- Producing HR reports and supporting HR projects as required.
- Ensuring confidential employee information is handled in line with GDPR requirements.

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience in an HR Administration role.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise a busy workload and meet deadlines.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- Experience using HR systems would be advantageous.
- CIPD Level 3 or working towards a qualification would be beneficial.

What you'll get in return
- Immediate start opportunity.
- Hybrid working options available.
- Competitive hourly rate.
- Valuable experience within a supportive HR team.
- Weekly pay through Hays.

What you need to do nowIf you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV. Please note that applications without a CV cannot be considered. If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Recruitment Account Coordinator
description:
Permanent - Full-time - On-Site - Monday-Friday (6:00am-2:30pm)

Salary: up to £27,500 per annum

Have you considered a career in recruitment? You possess drive, ambition, discipline, and structure, but haven't yet had the opportunity to put it all into practice? Come and showcase your potential at Staffline.

The Opportunity

This is your chance to join the UK's largest recruitment business as a Recruitment Account Coordinator. In this role, you'll be providing temporary workers to our highly successful warehousing operation in Crewe.

To excel in this role, your focus will be on customers, committed to delivering the best service, and a natural problem solver. While experience in on-site recruitment would be beneficial, it's not an essential requirement. If you have transferable skills, we can provide training on all the elements essential for success in this position.

What you'll do as a Account Coordinator

This role thrives on pace - helping candidates find the best jobs, solving problems, and enhancing the candidate experience and work environment. It's a wonderfully diverse role that will undoubtedly keep you engaged. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:
- Meeting client deadlines by fulfilling staffing requirements
- Recruitment, selection, and onboarding of workers
- Accurate data input and validation for weekly payroll
- Handling administrative processes such as absences and change requests
- Ensuring compliance and maintaining secure records for audits
- Providing a positive customer experience and efficiently addressing worker queries

The skills you'll develop as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

Throughout your time at Staffline, you'll receive coaching and challenges that will facilitate skill growth. In this role, you can anticipate enhancing skills related to client and relationship management, hiring and staffing processes, and identifying opportunities for performance improvement - among a range of other areas. At Staffline, we actively encourage progression and personal development, with dedicated progression paths for those who join us.

What we need from you

By now, it should be evident that we're dedicated to your development, fair rewards, and encouraging you to excel in your role at Staffline. To succeed in this position, a few things are required:
- Swift adaptation to changing priorities and effective problem-solving skills
- The confidence and ability to work on Microsoft Excel
- A customer-centric mindset, prioritizing people above all else
- Ideally, experience within the recruitment industry (though not essential)
- A growth mindset, consistently seeking innovative approaches while fulfilling both client and customer needs
- Strong relationship-building abilities, confidently establishing and maintaining connections with clients and customers
- Most importantly, tenacity, drive, flexibility, and a positive attitude toward delivering excellent service.

Diversity and Inclusion: A Core Focus

At Staffline, we are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that a diverse team brings different perspectives, ideas, and experiences, enhancing our overall effectiveness and success. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, and we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Intrigued? Why not apply now? Or if you need more information, get in touch!

Note: All candidates must demonstrate their Right to Work in the UK. A full UK driver's license is highly desired for this role.

title: Service Administrator
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are working on behalf of a reputable main dealer in Knutsford to recruit an experienced Service Administrator. This is a valuable opportunity for a professional with a passion for the automotive industry to join a leading dealership renowned for its excellent customer service and state-of-the-art facilities. The Service Administrator will play a vital role in ensuring smooth workshop operations and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Benefits include:
- Salary between £28,000 and £32,000, depending on experience
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced holiday entitlement
- Staff discounts on vehicle purchases and services
- Ongoing manufacturer-accredited training
- Clear career progression routes within a highly regarded dealer group
- Working in a professional, friendly environment at a prestigious dealership in Knutsford

Duties of a Service Administrator:
- Create, update, and manage job cards accurately to facilitate efficient workshop workflow
- Handle customer bookings, enquiries, and follow-up communications professionally via phone, email, and face-to-face
- Maintain the service department loading system by scheduling jobs in accordance with workshop priorities and technician availability
- Ensure all documentation is compliant with manufacturer standards and internal procedures as a Service Administrator
- Coordinate loan vehicle administration, including collection and return, maintaining clear communication with customers
- Explain completed work to customers, ensuring they understand and approve services carried out
- Collaborate with the service team to uphold high customer satisfaction standards
- Adhere to health and safety regulations, maintaining compliance with dealership policies

Requirements of a Service Administrator:
- Full UK driving licence
- Proven customer service skills, with the ability to build rapport and handle queries professionally
- Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a busy environment
- Proficiency in numeracy, literacy, and IT, including experience with service management systems (familiarity with Pinnacle, Kerridge, or similar software is advantageous)
- Previous experience in automotive service administration or a related administrative role is preferred but not essential; strong administrative backgrounds are encouraged to apply
- Smart appearance and a professional attitude to represent a premium brand
- Basic understanding of vehicle mechanics or willingness to learn
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team

Contact Matt Cross, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement covering Knutsford and Cheshire, today to discover more about this fantastic Service Administrator opportunity.

Perfect Placement are the UK's Leading Automotive Recruitment Agency so if you are looking for a Job get in touch today.

title: Contact Centre Agent - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Part-Time Payroll Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Adele Carr Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting on behalf of a well-established and highly respected accountancy practice for an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join their growing payroll team.

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a friendly, supportive business that continues to expand through organic growth and acquisition. The company offers a flexible approach to working hours, a collaborative team environment and genuine opportunities for your role to grow as the business continues to develop.

If you're an experienced Payroll Administrator looking for a part-time position that offers flexibility, stability and a great team culture, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Working alongside an experienced team, you'll support the day-to-day processing of multiple client payrolls, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with current payroll legislation.

The business is looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in delivering an exceptional service to clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls of up to 80 employees per payroll.
- Processing new starters, leavers, statutory payments, sickness, time sheets and payroll amendments.
- Carrying out National Minimum Wage checks.
- Assisting with the onboarding of new payroll clients.
- Responding to payroll queries via telephone, email and in person.
- Completing monthly pension uploads and reconciling pension contributions.
- Ensuring compliance with Pension Regulator requirements.
- Maintaining GDPR compliance and payroll accuracy.
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with the smooth running of the payroll function.

Working Hours

This role is offered on a part-time basis (15-22.5 hours per week).

The successful candidate must be available to work on Tuesdays, with flexibility around how the remaining hours are worked. The client is happy to consider shorter working days (for example, 6-hour days) or alternative working patterns to suit both the successful candidate and the needs of the business.

As the payroll department continues to grow, there is potential for additional hours in the future.

Benefits
- 36 days holiday inclusive of Bank Holidays/Christmas period (this is the full time equivalent)
- Pension scheme - 5% employer contribution
- Option to buy/sell a maximum of 5 days holiday
- Employee assistance programme (which includes; Life support, Legal information, Bereavement support, Medical Information, CBT & Managerial Support).
- Life Assurance cover
- Option of salary sacrifice pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity/paternity/shared parental pay
- Enhanced sick pay
- Referral scheme
- Paid volunteer time
- Long service enhancements to employer pension contribution and holiday entitlement
- On site parking
- Team social events

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking for genuine flexibility while continuing to build a career in payroll. Whether you're currently working within an accountancy practice or an in-house payroll team, this role offers the chance to join a growing business where your contribution will be valued and where there is real scope for your hours and responsibilities to develop over time.

If you're looking for a flexible part-time payroll opportunity with an employer that genuinely values its people, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Adele Carr Recruitment for a confidential discussion.
